props.description: `hover`: with a mouse, the actions stay hidden until the row is hovered, holds focus, is `active` or has a menu open, and then take the place of the rest of `InboxItemTrailing` (the timestamp, the marks, the attention dot), which steps aside. name: InboxItemLeadingBadge
description: A small badge in the bottom-right corner of `InboxItemLeading`, the corner a presence light takes: on a thread row, the thread mark, on the channel's `IconTile` or on the direct message's `Avatar` alike. Put it inside `InboxItemLeading`, after the tile or avatar, with one icon as its child; leave the avatar's `AvatarBadge` out, since the corner holds one mark. It is hidden from assistive technology unless given a `role`.
